canonical_name: Borel-Weil-Bott geometric realization by flag-variety line-bundle cohomology (exact variant open)
literal_source_claim_zh: 紧李群表示的几何实现
literal_source_claim_en: Geometric realization of representations of compact Lie groups.
statement_blocker: The title selects the full higher-cohomology Borel-Weil-Bott family, with degree-zero Borel-Weil only a special case. Fix the group and geometric category, maximal torus/Borel and flag variety, homogeneous line bundle and sign, integral weight and Weyl dot action, regular/singular cases, unique degree and vanishing, returned representation and dual convention, binders, and boundary cases. No exact authoritative source passage has been completely crosswalked, reviewed, and admitted, so choosing a familiar convention from memory would invent the theorem boundary.
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix the compact or complex semisimple group formulation, topology and connectedness, maximal torus/Borel and flag-variety carrier, analytic or algebraic category, scalar field, homogeneous line bundle, cohomology category, representation carrier and universes, and all typeclass assumptions.
conclusion: Prospective family only: cohomology of the homogeneous line bundle selected by an integral weight vanishes or is concentrated in a source-determined degree and realizes a source-determined irreducible representation. Exact regularity, singularity, degree, highest-weight, dual/sign, equivariance, isomorphism, and vanishing clauses remain open.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve trivial and rank-zero groups, central tori, disconnected groups, empty root systems, singular walls, non-integral and non-dominant weights, the degree-zero dominant case, Weyl-length zero, analytic/algebraic comparison, dualization, and line-bundle sign conventions.
